---
title: "1_Download_Datasets"
author: "Noor-Ul-Haya Ahmed"
date: "2026"
output: pdf_document
description: >
  Downloads raw transcriptomic datasets from GEO for integrative
  analysis of skeletal muscle in neurodegenerative diseases (ALS,
  PD, VCP/IBMPFD myopathy). Datasets are saved to raw_data/ for
  downstream preprocessing.
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "...") # make own directory
```

```{r libraries}
# ============================================================
# LIBRARIES
# ============================================================
library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)

# create output directories
dir.create("raw_data",       showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("metadata",       showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("clean_data",     showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("clean_metadata", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r download_microarray}
# ============================================================
# MICROARRAY DATASETS
# Affymetrix CEL files downloaded from GEO
# Datasets: GSE3307 (ALS), GSE26276 (ALS), GSE122261 (ALS),
#           GSE12685 (AD brain), GSE28146 (AD brain),
#           GSE30806 (VCP-myopathy)
# ============================================================

microarray_datasets <- c(
  "GSE3307",   # ALS skeletal muscle — primary ALS dataset
  "GSE26276",  # ALS skeletal muscle — directional evidence only
  "GSE122261", # ALS myotubes (cell line) — secondary
  "GSE12685",  # AD prefrontal cortex — brain comparator
  "GSE28146",  # AD hippocampus — brain comparator
  "GSE30806"   # VCP/IBMPFD myopathy skeletal muscle
)

for(gse_id in microarray_datasets){
  cat("\n=================================\n",
      "Downloading:", gse_id,
      "\n=================================\n")
  try({
    getGEOSuppFiles(gse_id, baseDir = "raw_data/")
    cat("Downloaded:", gse_id, "\n")
  })
}
```

```{r download_rnaseq}
# ============================================================
# RNA-SEQ DATASETS
# Count matrices downloaded from GEO supplementary files
# Datasets: GSE100188 (ALS small RNA), GSE140089 (PD),
#           GSE128177 (PD shared cohort)
# ============================================================

rnaseq_datasets <- c(
  "GSE100188", # ALS skeletal muscle — small RNA-seq
  "GSE140089", # PD skeletal muscle — primary PD dataset
  "GSE128177"  # PD skeletal muscle — shared cohort
)

for(gse_id in rnaseq_datasets){
  cat("\n=================================\n",
      "Downloading:", gse_id,
      "\n=================================\n")
  try({
    getGEOSuppFiles(gse_id, baseDir = "raw_data/")
    cat("Downloaded:", gse_id, "\n")
  })
}
```

```{r download_metadata}
# ============================================================
# DOWNLOAD SAMPLE METADATA
# Pulls pData from GEO series matrix files for all datasets
# Used to assign disease/control group labels
# ============================================================

all_datasets <- c(microarray_datasets, rnaseq_datasets)

for(gse_id in all_datasets){
  cat("\nPulling metadata for:", gse_id, "\n")
  try({
    gse <- getGEO(gse_id, GSEMatrix = TRUE, getGPL = FALSE)

    # handle list or single object
    if(is.list(gse)) gse <- gse[[1]]

    pdata <- pData(gse)

    write.csv(
      pdata,
      paste0("metadata/", gse_id, "_pdata.csv"),
      row.names = TRUE
    )

    cat("Saved metadata for:", gse_id, "\n")
    cat("Samples:", nrow(pdata), "\n")
  })
}

cat("\nAll downloads complete.\n")
cat("Check raw_data/ for expression files\n")
cat("Check metadata/ for sample metadata\n")
```

```{r check_downloads}
# ============================================================
# VERIFY DOWNLOADS
# ============================================================

cat("Files in raw_data/:\n")
list.files("raw_data", recursive = TRUE)

cat("\nMetadata files saved:\n")
list.files("metadata")
```
